transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant ISC role assignment APIs.
Let me get the full details on the access request operation and look for the revocation endpoint.

Both operations use the **same endpoint** — `POST /v3/access-requests` — distinguished only by the `requestType` field in the body.

---

## Grant a Role

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestedFor": ["2c918084660f45d6016617daa9210584"],
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ROLE",
      "id": "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581",
      "comment": "Granting role for project onboarding"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Revoke a Role

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestedFor": ["2c918084660f45d6016617daa9210584"],
  "requestType": "REVOKE_ACCESS",
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ROLE",
      "id": "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581",
      "comment": "Removing role — project complete"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Key details

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | Array of identity IDs to target |
| `requestType` | `GRANT_ACCESS` or `REVOKE_ACCESS` |
| `requestedItems[].type` | `ROLE` for roles; also supports `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ENTITLEMENT` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | The role's ID (find it via `GET /v3/roles`) |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | Optional but recommended for audit trail |

**Scope required:** `idn:access-request:manage` (or `idn:access-request-self:manage` if the caller is requesting for themselves).

The request goes through any configured approval workflows before the role is actually granted/revoked. A `200 OK` response means the request was **submitted**, not necessarily that it was approved.
